pages.summary: Jane ofrece a Pansy una primera práctica al volante. Hermione acepta acompañarlas con Robin.

panels.scene: Quiet parking lot wide view by closed graphite SUV. Jane in camel coat holds up a set of keys and smiles. Pansy turns to her with sudden surprise. Hermione stands separately by the back passenger door.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Hablas en serio?

panels.scene: Jane speaks calmly beside the SUV. Plenty of empty marked spaces and distant storefront behind her. Pansy listens, hands down.
dialogue: Jane: Completamente. Podemos practicar aquí, con espacio de sobra.

panels.scene: Hermione in plum coat and cream scarf raises her eyebrows toward Jane. Pansy looks amused without leaving the sidewalk.
dialogue: Hermione: Hace dos días no querías ni subirte a un automóvil.

panels.scene: Close Jane passes the keys by hand to Pansy, exactly one hand from each sleeve and clear anatomical fingers. No key thrown across scene.
dialogue: Pansy: Y ahora quiero saber cómo funciona.

panels.scene: Static cabin with the graphite SUV still parked. Camera through windshield: Jane sits front left in camel coat, Pansy front right at steering wheel, both belted. Hermione seated in rear with one charcoal shell centered.

panels.scene: Close side angle through rear passenger window, Robin securely reclined in his dark gray carrier with a small teddy on his lap, watched by belted Hermione. Pansy's shoulder forward in distant soft focus. No other infant.
panels.caption: Hermione se acomodó junto a Robin.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 12 · 33

Jane ofrece a Pansy una primera práctica al volante. Hermione acepta acompañarlas con Robin.
Pansy: ¿Hablas en serio?
Jane: Completamente. Podemos practicar aquí, con espacio de sobra.
Hermione: Hace dos días no querías ni subirte a un automóvil.

Jane: Empecemos despacio.
Narración: Hermione se acomodó junto a Robin.
pages.review: La vista desde fuera del parabrisas mantiene el volante británico. Jane ofrece las llaves, Hermione va atrás y Robin conserva silla, ropa y osito.

pages.summary: El automóvil avanza por el estacionamiento. Los limpiaparabrisas traicionan a Pansy durante el primer giro.

panels.scene: Side angle into the front cabin. Pansy holds the wheel with two natural hands, gaze on the clear parking aisle, Jane at left supervising. Both belted. No readable controls.
dialogue: Pansy: Estamos avanzando.

panels.scene: Wide outside shot of the graphite SUV turning slowly around an open row of parking spaces. One vehicle visible nearby parked, no bystanders close, clean pale daylight.
panels.caption: La primera vuelta fue a paso de tortuga.

panels.scene: From outside front window, wipers unexpectedly sweep across a dry windshield. Both faces visible and the wheel on vehicle's right. Pansy keeps her gaze forward, shoulders steady.
panels.caption: Al intentar señalar el giro, activó los limpiaparabrisas.

panels.scene: Close Pansy framed beside her headrest, dry sidelong smile but eyes on the clear road, hands on wheel. Hermione is off panel.
dialogue: Pansy: No digas nada, Granger.

panels.scene: Tight shot of Hermione, belted in the back, hiding her grin behind one hand. In the next layer, one dark gray carrier back and edge of cream fabric, no duplicate baby.
dialogue: Hermione: No he dicho nada.

panels.scene: Wide view from near a lamp at the safe side of the open aisle. The SUV is parked carefully between two white lines. Jane looks approving through the passenger window.
dialogue: Jane: Eso estuvo muy bien.

pages.summary: Jane celebra el primer recorrido de Pansy. Hermione admite que ha salido mejor de lo que esperaba.

panels.scene: Wide side exterior of the graphite SUV driving slowly along a quiet residential street, bare trees and Victorian homes. No hazard or traffic drama.
panels.caption: En la calle tranquila, Pansy siguió las indicaciones de Jane.

panels.scene: From passenger-side angle, Jane looks forward while Pansy stays focused on the road. Both are belted and in their established clothes.
dialogue: Jane: Muy bien, Schumacher.

panels.scene: After the SUV has come to a stop at the curb, Pansy looks toward Jane with one curious eyebrow. Hermione visible smiling from back. Pansy is framed on the LEFT and speaks first, Jane on the RIGHT and replies second, both faces clear.
dialogue: Pansy: ¿Quién es Schumacher?
Jane: Un piloto de carreras.

panels.scene: Close parked cabin. Pansy calmly returns keys to Jane with two naturally drawn hands. Hermione still seated in the back smiles; one dark shell edge can be seen.
dialogue: Pansy: Acabas de convertirte en mi persona favorita del mundo muggle.

panels.scene: Side view into the back, parked. Robin in the reclined child carrier, happily clutching the tiny star bear. Hermione's cream scarf and smile are nearby.
dialogue: Hermione: Nuestro hijo también cree que un elefante azul puede cantar.

panels.scene: Warm wide from the pavement. Jane now back in the front right driver's seat, Pansy approaching the front left passenger door. A winter sky between London terraces, no second car.
dialogue: Jane: Volvamos a casa antes de que quieras comprar un automóvil.
